data: Controlled synthetic Recorder series; qa_energy338 source, fixture@example.invalid recipient, sample CHF tariff. No home data or real recipients.
windows: Optimizer: current local day, 23 completed hours / 46 kWh. Earlier Insights: current day, 22 hours / 44 kWh. Email overview: rolling 24 hours / 48 kWh. Calendar preview: previous completed day, 24 hours / 48 kWh. Different windows are intentional.
email_preview: Actual backend 2.3.0 HTML, no message sent. Screenshot shows controls and upper report; full chart/table content is scrollable.
capture_limit: Rejected SDK images with missing text are excluded. Native screen comparison showed correct values. Original empty-state PNGs remain historical empty-state examples only. Raw SDK bytes were JPEG despite local diagnostic .png suffix; public .jpg files preserve original bytes.
reuse_after_capture: Later changes only add schedule-toggle classes and scoped CSS to legacy schedule labels, time/recipient inputs and selects. Captured Overview/Preview/Daily/Patterns views contain none of these schedule controls; their markup/styles remain unchanged. Affected native schedule targets are qualified separately. Captured_modules record capture-time hashes, not a claim that all final modules remain byte-identical.
